kind: Scripted rule checks; not participant tests

checks.name: Vision identities match P6-A contracts
Signal identities match P6-A contracts
Fault identities match P7-A contracts
Every resource exists in P4-D geometry or the Lab Map data (TRP-04 is a kit item only)
Every kit item is a known resource
Reserving before preparation is refused
One booking holds every item of KIT-C1-v1
Starting before check-in is refused
Check-in accepts the booked station typed loosely (cv2 → CV-02)
Check-in marks the kit as in use, separately from availability
Session cannot start until the kit matches the manifest
Session starts with a complete kit
Evidence keeps its settings and source
Recorded evidence cannot be overwritten
Submitting without a saved claim returns to review with the gap named
Submission issues the P6-A receipt
A second submit returns the same receipt
Complete return closes the session and frees every resource
Signal session starts with no portable items to count
Signal submission issues its own receipt
Signal session closes without a kit return
The drawn alias passes through every sample (max error < 1e-9)
3 Hz sampling of 2 Hz aliases to 1 Hz; 20 Hz does not alias
A taken slot is refused and names the clash
The refusal offers the compatible 11:00 slot (P6-A recovery contract)
The conflict does not block the signal kit at the same time
Wrong station is refused, names the expected one, and records no attendance
An unknown ID gets a format hint rather than a wrong-station message
Device failure preserves saved captures and blocks new ones
Report creates ISS-0417 linked to the booking
A report alone restricts nothing
A second report for the same asset is not duplicated
Restriction is refused before classification
Triage previews the bookings that hold the asset
Restriction is scoped to C1-CAM only
B-2047 and B-2049 are affected; B-2048 and KIT-S1-v1 are not (P7-A contract)
Equipment list, kit, slots and Lab Map data all show the restriction
Public notice names the equipment but no issue, person, booking or cause
The student can finish with a prepared condition, labelled as such
Release is refused before verification
Verification is refused before a repair is recorded
Interrupted verification keeps the issue open and the restriction on (unknown cause)
Release lifts the restriction and restores B-2047 and B-2049
Maintenance history records report, classification, restriction, repair, both verifications and release
Every log line has actor, time, reference and action
Reserving a kit with a restricted item is refused and names the item
The signal experiment can still be reserved
Quality classification leaves the asset bookable and closes without verification
A failed save keeps the text and does not claim it was saved
An unsaved claim blocks submission
A missing acknowledgement is not reported as submitted
Retry uses the same request and yields one receipt
A too-short claim is refused with the reason
A short return blocks closing and names CAL-01 0 of 1
Closing with a follow-up raises FU-2041 and marks CAL-01 location unknown
The missing item blocks the next reservation of the kit
Open bookings that hold CAL-01 are marked affected; the signal booking is not
Locating the item closes FU-2041 and restores the kit and its bookings
State is plain data: a storage round trip changes nothing
